prompts.title: Weekly report
prompts.summary: A weekly report from your commits
prompts.prompt: Look at the Git commits in the workspace from the last week and write a weekly report grouped by project: what was finished, problems hit, and next week's plan. Output in Markdown.

prompts.title: Understand an error
prompts.prompt: I will paste an error message. Explain the cause, give the most likely fix, and say how to confirm it is fixed. The error is:

prompts.title: Data into a chart
prompts.prompt: Turn the data I give you next into a table, work out the totals and the change from last period, then draw a suitable chart. The data is:

prompts.title: Learn a language in two weeks
prompts.prompt: I want to get started with Rust in two weeks. Give me a day-by-day study plan with one small exercise a day, and start me on day one's exercise now.

prompts.title: Write a project README
prompts.prompt: Read the project in the workspace and write a README: a one-line intro, features, installation, usage examples and the folder layout.

prompts.title: Plan a trip
prompts.prompt: Help me plan a three-day trip to Hangzhou: each day's route, transport, what to eat, and a rough budget. I like quiet places.
